result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign for straightforward, everyday contract signing**, or **DocuSign if you want a more established platform that can grow with your business**\.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, how many people need access, and whether you need more than just signatures.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses (2026)

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Simple to use and quick to set up.
- Signature requests, templates and audit trails.
- Good Dropbox and cloud-storage integration.
- Paid plans offer unlimited signature requests.

Indicative starting price: around \$15/month.

[Dropbox Sign website](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![AlignedPartner - Partner Program Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6SBWynbkn-bwRkCuMIHuBO284Y100e0fDpdUDFLZztrUUgkyW1-tpHcC5kTOqtjz5KB_xBScAISRTstaI0F65z5jXu0N46he4NZBZ6WfWk96sgJLpvvT2RrcS-xO0hh1EvFzwRy6VbJduS4ruy6JYed3q5wUxhQz8NAeUe2M3V1pVOdebhqoA5Ko-m3kjQ5x?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best overall for growth)

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Strong integrations with business software.
- Templates, reminders and signing workflows.
- Good for businesses handling more complex agreements.

Indicative starting price: around \$11–15/month.

[DocuSign website](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for sales teams)

- Create professional proposals and quotations.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Collect signatures in the same workflow.

Indicative starting price: around \$19/user/month.

[PandaDoc website](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

- Straightforward signing process.
- Reusable templates.
- Free tier for occasional use.
- Affordable paid plans.

Indicative starting price: around \$10/month.

[SignWell website](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF workflows)

- Excellent PDF editing and signing.
- Works well with Microsoft 365.
- Useful for businesses handling lots of formal paperwork.

Pricing varies by plan.

[Adobe Acrobat Sign website](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/sign.html)

## My recommendation

If I were choosing for a small business, I'd narrow it down to these three\:

| Your business requirement | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Send contracts for customers to sign | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional, scalable contract management | DocuSign |
| Create quotes, proposals and contracts | PandaDoc |


**One important consideration for UK businesses\:** Check that the software provides a downloadable signed document, timestamped audit trail and evidence of signer identity and consent. Electronic signatures are generally legally recognised in England and Wales, but certain documents have additional formalities. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
